title: TCAQ - New Year's Eve Celebration
intro: Ring in the New Year at The Clubs. Enjoy a delectable buffet and dance into the New Year with DJ BASS. A selfie station will be available for all to capture those amazing memories. This event is open to the public.

sections.markdown:
**Date:** Thursday, December 31, 2026 - Friday, January 1, 2027

**Time:** 8:00 PM - 12:00 AM

**Address:** [The Clubs at Quantico, 3017 Russell Rd, Quantico, VA 22134](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=38.51022301434779,-77.31061124440777)

**Contact:** Phone: [703.784.4264](tel:703.784.4264)

sections.heading: NEW YEAR'S EVE CELEBRATION AT THE CLUBS AT QUANTICO
sections.markdown:
New this year! Bring the kids and enjoy a delicious buffet from 8–10 PM. Seating is limited and children must exit the event by 10 PM.

**Package A ($65):** A delectable buffet will be available at two seating times: 8 PM and 9 PM. PLUS all the festivities from Package B and a complimentary 187ml bottle of Champagne (included with Package A only).

**Package B ($45):** Bring the kids and enjoy the delectable buffet from 8:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m. Children must exit the event by 10:00 p.m. Kids under 12 years old ($22.50)

**Package C ($35): 10 PM ENTRANCE** - Cocktail Style, Standing Room Only with Party Favors, Hors D'Oeuvres, and a Champagne Toast at Midnight

All ticket purchases are subject to Eventbrite service and processing fees. These fees are visible before checkout – displayed alongside ticket prices – and are non-refundable.

Click here to [PURCHASE TICKETS ON EVENTBRITE](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/new-years-eve-celebration-at-the-clubs-at-quantico-tickets-1999376648377?aff=oddtdtcreator)

For more information, please call 703.784.4264.

With the purchase of your New Year's Eve Celebration tickets, you qualify for special rates at the Inns of the Corps. It is adjacent to TCAQ and within walking distance. See Eventbrite for details.

New Year's Celebration at The Clubs is open to the public. Each adult guest is required to have a DBIDS pass to enter Marine Corps Base Quantico. For your visit, go to: https://www.quantico.marines.mil/Info/Base-Access/Visitor-Control-Center/
